## What this surface is

OpenDefendable is an open-source truth surface in formation for
accountable AI systems.

- Status: READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS
- Role: public scoreboard, protocols, audit links, utilities, and contribution lanes
- Movement participation surface: yes
- Formal standards body: no
- Certification authority: no

## What exists publicly today

- Public scoreboard of wins and losses
- Protocol documents
- Audit index and tribunal links
- Contribution guidance
- Limitations and roadmap records

- Public demo: READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS

## Purpose

Use OpenDefendable to inspect:
- protocols
- audits
- repair queues
- open-source utilities
- current limitations
- contribution lanes

Do not treat this surface as:
- a formal standards body
- production clearance
- certification
- insurance coverage
- external enforcement approval

## Hash limitation

SHA-256 hashes in linked audit materials establish content-integrity
linkage only. They do not independently prove authorship, owner
approval, trusted timestamping, immutability, blockchain anchoring,
external attestation, certification, insurance coverage, or external
platform enforcement.
